migration_and_rollback.projection_note: The change is confined to the existing compile_relation_blocks owner. Reverting the implementation and test-consolidation commits restores the prior GPU-53 refusal behavior without rewriting history.

title: Align same-plane ForestEdge admission with retained Fourfold authority

masterplan.active_delivery_gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

result.summary: The canonical multi-relation compiler now matches the strict Boolean Fourfold projection for same-plane ForestEdge retention. A matching same-plane ForestEdge whose canonical digest is absent from PlaneSnapshot.relation_sha256s is omitted from the regenerable Tensor view rather than failing the projection or being reintroduced as a second authority.
result.discover_all: Unretained same-plane ForestEdge signatures are not discovered.
result.explicit_selection: An explicitly selected same-plane signature still yields a valid empty closed-world block when its complete Fourfold plane retained no matching edge digest.
result.retained_rows: Retained directed same-plane rows continue to compile and Boolean output is digest-equivalent to boolean_relation_block_from_fourfold.
result.refusal_boundaries: Retained undirected ForestEdge and retained ForestHyperedge refusal semantics remain owned by the existing compiler/projection tests; cross-plane verified-binding authority is unchanged.

implementation.behavior: compile_relation_blocks prunes explicitly unrelated same-plane edges before relation hashing, hashes relevant same-plane edges once for Fourfold retention, skips unretained rows, and only adds retained directed rows to discovery/fact materialization.
implementation.gardener: The correction stays in the existing compiler owner. No third projection authority, verifier, cache, registry, adapter family, fact store, backend or public API was introduced. A temporary duplicate regression file created in the first implementation commit was removed in the follow-up test-consolidation commit; its commit remains reachable as negative/fixup evidence.

supersession.gpu53: GPU-53 remains immutable historical evidence of the earlier fail-closed interpretation. GPU-59 supersedes only its same-plane unretained ForestEdge refusal expectation with cross-projection regression evidence; no history was rewritten or deleted.
supersession.gpu58: GPU-58's frozen correction target is implemented: align compile_relation_blocks with the strict Fourfold projector rather than creating another authority.
